title: Spec pack
description: One repository's spec pack (<work>/spec-<slug>.pack.json), handed to its spec authors, its spec reviewer and its task decomposer as `spec pack`. The step `spec_authoring.context` (orchestrator/flows/spec_authoring.py, with orchestrator/flows/spec_pack.py) writes it beside the repository context and validates it against this file. It is the session's view of the vault and the matrix for this Story: the entries it builds, the constraints and shared capabilities that bind the entries, the TRD requirements that bind them and the contract files the repository holds today. The headings the Story's scopes name are in the repository context's `documents`; `atw-matrix heading '<path>#<heading>'` prints a heading's text as the vault's last commit holds it (the approved architecture). Read the pack, not the vault and not the matrix; run `atw-matrix node` only for an entry the pack does not hold.

slug.description: The repository's slug, as the work files name it.

entries.description: Each stack the Story builds in and each entry it builds there, as the repository context's `stacks` name them.

kind.description: The entry's kind; null when the matrix holds no such entry.

resourceType.description: The AWS resource type of an infrastructure or component entry; null when it has none.

approved.description: Whether the entry carries the approved mark; null when the matrix does not hold the entry.

constraints.description: Each constraint that binds a stack the Story builds in or an entry it builds, once, as `atw-matrix story-scope` prints it: the constraint (with its `statement`, or `trd` for a TRD requirement), where it is stated and what it applies to.

capabilities.description: Each shared capability the entries must use, once, as `atw-matrix story-scope` prints it: the feature, the `provides` items relied on and their providers. Specify no behaviour a shared capability provides.

trd.description: The TRD requirements that bind what the Story builds.

requirements.description: Each requirement a constraint among `constraints` points at, then each requirement of this Epic's TRD that applies to the Epic as a whole.

requirement.description: The requirement's id, its heading in its TRD.

epic.description: The Epic whose TRD states it.

constraint.description: The matrix constraint that points at it.

text.description: The requirement's text in this Epic's TRD; null for another Epic's TRD (read it at the heading named by its id in the TRD at that Epic bead's `artifact_trd_path` metadata) or when the TRD has no such heading.

contractFiles.description: The OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL and JSON Schema files the repository holds today, by path under the repository, outside its tool, dependency and build folders. A spec that changes one of these contracts names the file.
